portfolio.title: Enterprise Web Platform
portfolio.shortDescription: Scalable web platform to support increasing traffic and complex business workflows.
portfolio.fullDescription: Designed and developed a modular, performance-optimised web application with a scalable architecture to handle high traffic and complex business operations.
portfolio.challenge: The client needed a scalable web platform to support increasing traffic and complex business workflows with high reliability and performance requirements.
portfolio.solution: We designed and developed a modular web application using Next.js and Node.js, implementing microservices architecture for scalability and performance optimization.

portfolio.title: Mobile Application for Service Management
portfolio.shortDescription: Cross-platform mobile application to streamline service requests and improve response times.
portfolio.fullDescription: Built a comprehensive mobile solution that streamlined manual service processes, improved team visibility, and reduced response times by 60%.
portfolio.challenge: Manual service requests caused delays and lack of visibility across teams, leading to inefficient operations and customer dissatisfaction.
portfolio.solution: We built a cross-platform mobile application using React Native with real-time notifications, GPS tracking, and integrated communication features.
results: 50% increase in daily service requests handled

portfolio.title: Customer Engagement Platform
portfolio.shortDescription: UI/UX redesign for SaaS product to improve user navigation and task completion.
portfolio.fullDescription: Complete redesign of customer-facing platform with focus on user experience, resulting in significant improvements in engagement and conversion rates.
portfolio.challenge: Users struggled with navigation and task completion due to a complex interface, leading to high bounce rates and low conversion.
portfolio.solution: We conducted comprehensive user research and redesigned the entire user experience with simplified flows, modern UI patterns, and intuitive navigation.
